name: Kobayakawa
summary: Bluffing card game where the lowest card gains the revealed Kobayakawa bonus and highest total wins bets.
rules_text: Each player gets 4 kamons and one hidden card from a 1-15 deck; one card is revealed as Kobayakawa. Place 8 kamons in the center pot. Each round has a Draw phase: in turn order each player either draws from deck to keep one of the two cards discarding the other face-up, or blindly replaces the Kobayakawa card. Then Fight phase: in order each player chooses to bet 1 kamon to fight or pass. Only fighters reveal. The fighter with the lowest card adds the Kobayakawa value to his total; highest total wins. Winner takes all bet kamons plus 1 from center. Ties broken by earlier turn order. If sole fighter, wins without revealing. Winner becomes start player. Players with 0 kamons are eliminated. Continue until 2 kamons remain in center; last round costs 2 kamons to fight and winner takes both remaining. Most kamons at end wins.
rating_reason: Kobayakawa card bluffing game ideal hidden hand bidding.
